headline: Running is back, and it landed with genuine intensity — the first run in the gap touched the top end. The blind spot from the off-stretch has its first fresh reading. Base remains deep.
confidence_reasons: Limited data sources active in last 3 days

sections.overview: The off-stretch has ended, and it ended in a more informative way than a plodding easy shakeout would have — the return run carried real range, reaching into Z4 rather than sitting quietly in aerobic territory. That's a useful data point: the trail block absorbed cleanly enough that the top end responded on the first ask, and easy-to-moderate HR held sensible ground within a mixed-effort session. Strength touched down once more before this run but still hasn't strung together a rhythm; it remains sporadic rather than a rebuilt block. Steps stayed high throughout the pause, carrying the background load while structured work was quiet, which is exactly why the base underneath never eroded. The cardio-load status still reads as depleted, which simply reflects the quiet stretch and will refill now that structured running has resumed — treat it as a lagging descriptor, not a warning.
sections.trends: The year-to-date picture is unambiguous — running volume this year sits far ahead of the same point last year, and the recent four-week window carried a huge trail block that dwarfed the prior month. Against that backdrop, the recent quiet stretch reads as a natural trough after a large loading spike, not a stall. The shape is cyclical: big block, absorption, restart — which fits year-round hybrid readiness rather than any drift toward detraining. What the trend now needs is for the restart to build a modest rhythm rather than remaining a single data point.
sections.threshold: The threshold reading hasn't been refreshed since early July, so the current figure is a stored value rather than a live one. Nothing in the recent data challenges it — the base is intact and the top-end response on the return run is encouraging — but until a genuine tempo or threshold effort lands, treat the number as a floor of demonstrated capacity rather than a current measurement. It remains the biggest unverified metric alongside VO2max.
sections.zones: The weekly aggregate has been almost entirely Z1 for weeks — the trail block was pure time-on-feet, and the pause added nothing. Today's return run is the first session in a long while to distribute across the zones, with meaningful minutes in Z2 and Z3 and a genuine Z4 touch. That's the right character for a first run back: not a grey-zone slog, but a session that actually sampled the spectrum. One session doesn't rebuild an intensity distribution, but it re-opens the upper zones after a long absence and confirms they're accessible.
sections.hr_comparison: Strength HR remains estimate-derived and the most recent lift didn't capture a reading at all, so there's little to compare on that front — the pattern across prior sessions stays consistent with moderate, mostly-aerobic strength work. On the run side, the return session's HR shape looks internally coherent, with the max sitting where you'd expect for a session that pushed into Z4. No source-agreement concerns worth flagging.
sections.calendar: The running streak has held across the quiet stretch on the strength of very light or minimal weeks, which is why it survived while structured running paused. Strength frequency, by contrast, is the thin spot — isolated sessions without a repeating weekly cadence. The return run breaks the running drought cleanly; the thing the calendar is now waiting on is whether either discipline settles into a repeatable pattern rather than one-off appearances.
sections.personal_bests: The speed PBs date from last autumn and sit well inside a focus that has been all endurance and time-on-feet lately — none are within reach until faster work returns and threshold is re-verified. The ultra-distance PB, by contrast, is well supported by the recent trail block and the year's volume. No PB is imminent, but the return of top-end range is the first prerequisite for the shorter ones re-entering the conversation.

watch_items: Watch whether running settles into a repeatable weekly rhythm now that the drought is broken, or reverts to isolated sessions.
Watch for a genuine tempo or threshold effort to refresh the stale threshold reading — still the largest unverified metric.
Watch whether strength finally builds a consistent cadence rather than sporadic single sessions.
Watch how easy-run HR behaves on the next few runs now that the top end has confirmed a clean response.
